verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents its own bulk capabilities: a CSV template for uploading a batch of manual journal entries at once, CSV bulk add or edit of the Chart of Accounts, and a 'Batch Categorize Transactions' help article. These are UI or CSV-import flows for specific item types, though. Nothing shows bulk actions driven programmatically or by agents (API, MCP) for an AI-native workflow, and the batch-categorize capability is only a title with no detail. missing for 10: programmatic/agent-driven bulk operations via API or MCP, documented details of batch transaction categorization, general bulk edit/delete across arbitrary item types, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Instead of adding them one by one, you can upload a batch of entries all at once using Puzzle's CSV import template.
If you need to bulk add or edit your Chart of Accounts in Puzzle, you can do so by uploading a CSV file directly from your Company Settings.
